changelog: - **Selection and keyboard focus stay visible when zoomed out.** Below 75 % the selection ring no longer thins with the zoom: it keeps a visible band close to the node's outline, so a selected node still reads at the overview. Below 80 %, where the inside dashed focus ring was under a pixel, keyboard focus is shown as four short corner marks just outside the node, also on a selected node and clear of the hover highlight's ring; from 80 % up the dashed ring is back. On a selected Register with an error, the dashed error ring stays outside the selection ring and readable as dashes. A pressed tool, connect kind or status toggle now writes its word in a darker blue, easier to read on its tint; its ring is unchanged.
